about_zh: IM、机器人、社交平台与社区协作。

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: A plugin for Mac WeChat
repos.summary_zh: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
repos.summary_en: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

repos.description: 微信小助手
repos.summary_zh: WeChatPlugin-MacOS 是一款 macOS 平台的微信小助手工具，旨在提升用户工作效率。它通过自动化消息处理、快捷回复、群管理等功能，简化日常沟通流程，支持多账号管理，适用于需要高效处理微信消息的 macOS 用户。
repos.summary_en: WeChatPlugin-MacOS is a macOS assistant tool for WeChat, designed to enhance productivity. It automates message handling, enables quick replies, and supports group management, streamlining daily communication. Ideal for macOS users managing multiple WeChat accounts efficiently.

repos.description: 微信机器人 / 可能是最优雅的微信个人号 API ✨✨
repos.summary_zh: wxpy 是基于 itchat 封装的优雅微信个人号 API，提供对象化接口与丰富功能扩展，支持自动回复、消息转发、好友管理、智能家居控制等场景，集成聊天机器人与实用工具组件，兼容 Python 2.7 及 3.4-3.6，适合实现微信自动化操作。
repos.summary_en: wxpy is an elegant WeChat personal account API built on itchat, offering object-oriented interfaces and extensive feature extensions. It supports auto-reply, message forwarding, friend/group management, smart home control, and integrates chatbots and utilities. Compatible with Python 2.7 and 3.4-3.6, ideal for WeChat automation.

repos.description: 微信《跳一跳》Python 辅助
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个基于 Python 的微信小游戏《跳一跳》自动化辅助工具，通过图像识别技术自动识别棋子位置与目标方块，结合 ADB 控制手机屏幕实现精准跳跃。支持手动校准与自动识别两种模式，利用像素距离计算按压时长，帮助用户高效刷分登顶排行榜。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Python-based automation tool for WeChat's mini-game 'Jump Jump'. It uses image recognition to detect the player's position and target blocks, calculates the required press duration based on pixel distance, and controls the screen via ADB to achieve precise jumps, enabling automatic high-score gameplay.

repos.description: A command-line tool for tweaking WeChat - 首款微信 macOS 客户端撤回拦截与多开 🔨
repos.summary_zh: WeChatTweak 是一款专为 macOS 设计的命令行工具，支持微信客户端撤回消息拦截、阻止自动更新及多开功能，通过二进制补丁技术实现原生应用增强，显著提升微信使用灵活性与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: WeChatTweak is a command-line tool for macOS that enables WeChat enhancements including message recall blocking, auto-update prevention, and multi-instance support via binary patching, offering advanced customization for native app workflows.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

repos.description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
repos.summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

repos.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
repos.summary_zh: Guizang Social Card Skill 是一款面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Agent 的图文卡片生成技能，专为小红书图文与公众号封面设计。内置 Editorial 与 Swiss 两套视觉系统，提供 28 种版式与 10 套主题，支持单文件 HTML 转 PNG，无需前端构建，自动适配多尺寸输出，集成图片搜索、地图组件与校验脚本，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Social Card Skill is an AI agent skill for Claude Code/Codex that generates Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs. It features Editorial and Swiss visual systems with 28 layouts and 10 themes, converting single-file HTML to PNG without build tools. Includes image sourcing, map components, and validation scripts for streamlined social content creation.

repos.description: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
repos.summary_zh: wxauto 是一个基于 Windows 平台、使用 UIAutomation 技术实现的微信客户端自动化工具，支持消息发送与接收，适用于开发简单微信机器人的场景。项目于2025年10月28日停止维护，仅支持微信3.9.x版本及Windows 10/11或Server 2016+系统。
repos.summary_en: wxauto is a Windows-based automation tool for the WeChat desktop client (non-web version) using UIAutomation technology. It enables basic message sending and receiving, suitable for building simple WeChat bots. The project was discontinued on October 28, 2025, supporting WeChat 3.9.x and Windows 10/11 or Server 2016+. It is intended solely for technical learning and not for production or illegal use.

repos.description: 消息推送平台🔥 推送下发【邮件】【短信】【微信服务号】【微信小程序】【企业微信】【钉钉】等消息类型。
repos.summary_zh: Austin 是一个企业级统一消息推送平台，支持邮件、短信、微信、钉钉、企业微信等10+渠道的消息下发，具备全链路追踪、资源隔离、定时任务等能力，采用 SpringBoot + Kafka + Redis + Xxl-Job 等技术栈，适用于业务通知、营销触达等场景。
repos.summary_en: Austin is an enterprise-grade unified messaging push platform supporting 10+ channels including email, SMS, WeChat, DingTalk, and enterprise WeChat. It features full-lifecycle tracking, channel isolation, and scheduled delivery via cron. Built with SpringBoot, Kafka, Redis, and Xxl-Job, it serves business notifications and marketing campaigns.

repos.description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
repos.summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
repos.summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

repos.description: 微信公共平台消息接口服务中间件
repos.summary_zh: Node.js 微信公众平台消息接口中间件，支持文本、图片、语音、视频、音乐、图文等多种自动回复，提供会话管理和多客服转发功能，适用于公众号开发快速集成消息处理逻辑。
repos.summary_en: A Node.js middleware for WeChat Official Platform message interface, supporting automatic replies (text, image, voice, video, music, news), session management, and customer service transfer, enabling rapid integration of message handling logic for official accounts.

repos.description: 查看被删的微信好友
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过微信网页版接口检测被删除好友，原理为新建群组测试好友是否可添加。因接口存在人数限制及微信策略变更，已无法正常使用。推荐替代方案包括网页版微信API及Electron桌面客户端，支持Python、Go、Node.js等多语言实现。
repos.summary_en: This project detects WeChat users who deleted you by creating group tests via the web interface. It is now unusable due to API rate limits and policy changes. Alternatives include web-based WeChat APIs and Electron desktop clients, with implementations in Python, Go, and Node.js.

repos.description: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
repos.summary_zh: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
repos.summary_en: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

repos.description: WeRoBot 是一个微信公众号开发框架
repos.summary_zh: WeRoBot 是一个基于 Python 的微信公众号开发框架，采用 MIT 协议开源。它提供简洁的装饰器语法处理消息事件，支持文本、图片、事件等交互类型，内置消息解析、签名校验和自动回复功能，极大简化微信公众号后端开发流程。
repos.summary_en: WeRoBot is a Python-based WeChat Official Account development framework licensed under MIT. It offers a clean decorator syntax for handling message events like text, images, and events, with built-in message parsing, signature verification, and auto-reply capabilities, streamlining backend development for WeChat Official Accounts.

repos.description: 拼多多、千牛、抖店 AI 客服机器人：自动回复客户咨询、商品答疑、售后申诉处理，支持微信、小红书、京东、抖音、B站、微博等多平台统一接待；可接入 DeepSeek / 通义千问 等大模型，支持自有知识库定制。
repos.summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
repos.summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

repos.description: WeChat SDK for Python
repos.summary_zh: WeChatpy 是一个功能完整的微信公众平台第三方 Python SDK，支持普通公众平台被动响应、企业微信、微信支付、第三方平台代调用及小程序云开发等核心 API 集成，提供简洁易用的接口封装，适用于快速构建微信生态应用。
repos.summary_en: WeChatpy is a comprehensive third-party Python SDK for the WeChat public platform, supporting core APIs such as passive response, enterprise WeChat, WeChat Pay, third-party proxy calls, and mini-program cloud development, offering a clean interface for rapid integration into WeChat ecosystem applications.

repos.description: WeChat local data CLI with daemon architecture
repos.summary_zh: wx-cli 是一款基于 Rust 开发的本地微信数据命令行工具，支持会话、聊天记录、联系人、群成员、收藏、朋友圈等数据的毫秒级查询与导出。采用守护进程架构实现高效缓存，零依赖安装，支持 YAML/JSON 输出，专为 AI Agent 和开发者设计，数据完全本地化处理，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: wx-cli is a Rust-based CLI tool for querying local WeChat data, including chats, contacts, groups, favorites, and Moments. It features a daemon architecture for millisecond-level response, zero-dependency installation, YAML/JSON output, and full local data processing, making it ideal for AI agents and developers.

repos.description: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
repos.summary_zh: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
repos.summary_en: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

repos.description: 云微WOC，云微信，自由连接
repos.summary_zh: 云微（WechatOnCloud）是一款自托管的微信多端共享解决方案，允许用户在 NAS 或服务器上通过 Docker 运行官方原版微信，并让多个浏览器设备共享同一微信会话。其核心采用 Xvfb 虚拟显示 + KasmVNC 串流技术，配合自研面板实现实例生命周期管理、RBAC 权限控制、文件传输及多端协作软锁，支持 amd64/arm64 架构与 PWA 安装，适用于家庭或团队跨设备统一微信使用场景。
repos.summary_en: WechatOnCloud (WOC) is a self-hosted solution that runs the official WeChat desktop client in Docker containers, enabling multiple browser-based devices to share a single WeChat session. It leverages Xvfb virtual display and KasmVNC streaming, with a custom panel for instance lifecycle management, RBAC permissions, file transfer, and collaborative soft-locking. Supporting amd64/arm64 and PWA, it's ideal for unified cross-device WeChat access in homes or teams.

repos.description: 面向 AI Agent 的微信公众号创作与发布 CLI：Markdown 排版、AI 配图、预览与草稿创建；支持由浏览器 Agent 保存知乎、CSDN、头条未发布草稿。
repos.summary_zh: md2wechat 是一款专为 AI 时代设计的公众号创作工具，支持用 Markdown 编写文章并一键转换为精美排版，自动上传至微信草稿箱。提供 43 个高级排版模块、40+ 专业主题、AI 配图及批量发布功能，全流程 CLI 操作，兼容 Claude Code 等智能体，让公众号写作高效如发朋友圈。
repos.summary_en: md2wechat is an AI-native WeChat article creation tool that converts Markdown into beautifully formatted posts and auto-uploads to the draft box. It offers 43 advanced layout modules, 40+ professional themes, AI image generation, and batch publishing via CLI, with native support for agents like Claude Code.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，实时更新，导出和修改聊天记录，朋友圈，收藏，自动回复等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: 一个基于✨HOOK机制的微信机器人，支持🌱安全新闻定时推送【FreeBuf，先知，安全客，奇安信攻防社区】，👯Kfc文案，⚡漏洞查询，⚡手机号归属地查询，⚡知识库查询，🎉星座查询，⚡天气查询，🌱摸鱼日历，⚡微步威胁情报查询， 🐛视频，⚡图片，👯帮助菜单。📫 支持积分功能，⚡支持自动拉人，，🌱自动群发，👯Ai回复（国内主流AI模型，扣子，FastGpt，Dify全面支持！），⚡视频号解析，😄自定义程度丰富，小白也可轻松上手！
repos.summary_zh: NGCBot 是一款基于 HOOK 机制的微信机器人，集成安全资讯推送、AI 智能回复、漏洞查询、天气日历等丰富功能，支持主流 AI 平台，具备自动拉群、群发、视频解析等自动化能力，自定义程度高，适合安全从业者与社群运营。
repos.summary_en: NGCBot is a HOOK-based WeChat robot supporting security news push, AI replies, vulnerability queries, weather, calendar, and more. It integrates with major AI platforms, offers automation features like auto-invite and group messaging, and is highly customizable for non-technical users.

repos.description: Social auth made simple
repos.summary_zh: Python Social Auth 是一个简单易用的社交认证/注册机制库，支持多种框架和第三方认证提供商。基于 django-social-auth 重构，提供统一接口定义新认证源，并扩展对更多框架和 ORM 的支持。该项目已于2016年12月3日停止维护，代码已迁移至 python-social-auth 组织。
repos.summary_en: Python Social Auth is a simple social authentication/registration library supporting multiple frameworks and auth providers. Built on django-social-auth, it offers a unified interface to define third-party authentication providers and extend support for additional frameworks and ORMs. Deprecated since Dec 3, 2016, with code migrated to the python-social-auth organization.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: 🎒 钉钉 & 🤖 GPT-3.5 让你的工作效率直接起飞 🚀 私聊群聊方式、单聊串聊模式、角色扮演、图片创作 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go语言开发的钉钉ChatGPT机器人，集成GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini模型，支持私聊、群聊、角色扮演、图片生成等功能，提供Docker部署和Azure-OpenAI支持，显著提升办公沟通效率。
repos.summary_en: A Go-based ChatGPT bot integrated with DingTalk, supporting GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini models, featuring private/group chat, role-playing, image generation, and Azure-OpenAI compatibility via Docker deployment for enhanced workplace productivity.

repos.description: A high performance open-source forum software written in PHP. Discussions Tags based with Quora/StackOverflow style.
repos.summary_zh: Carbon-Forum 是一款高性能开源 PHP 论坛系统，采用 Quora/StackOverflow 式标签讨论机制，支持移动端适配、实时推送、异步设计和完整 SEO 优化，具备现代通知中心与草稿保存功能，适用于构建高效知识分享社区。
repos.summary_en: Carbon-Forum is a high-performance open-source PHP forum software featuring Quora/StackOverflow-style discussion tags, mobile support, real-time notifications, asynchronous architecture, and full SEO optimization, ideal for building efficient knowledge-sharing communities.

repos.description: Connect to any agents with WeChat ClawBot.
repos.summary_zh: WeClaw 是一个 WeChat AI Agent 桥接工具，支持连接 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。通过 QR 码登录微信后自动检测并集成已安装的 AI 代理，提供 ACP/CLI/HTTP 三种交互模式，支持消息转发、图片文件传输、Markdown 转换及主动推送功能，具备持久化配置和命令行/API 双重控制能力。
repos.summary_en: WeClaw is a WeChat AI Agent Bridge that connects WeChat to AI agents like Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It auto-detects installed agents via QR login, supports ACP/CLI/HTTP modes, handles media/image forwarding, converts markdown responses, and enables proactive messaging via CLI or HTTP API with persistent config.

repos.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Golang 开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持 Docker 一键部署（镜像仅 2MB），提供每日 10 万次推送额度，支持原生弹窗与声音提醒，具备多用户管理、自定义跳转页面及无限换肤功能，适用于个人及小型项目消息通知场景。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, supporting one-click Docker deployment (2MB image), 100K daily push quota, native pop-up and sound alerts, multi-user support, customizable redirect pages, and unlimited skin switching, ideal for personal and small-scale notification systems.

repos.description: Flarum - 优雅自由的 PHP 轻社区
repos.summary_zh: Flarum 是一款基于 PHP 和 Mithril 框架的自由开源轻量级论坛软件，以简洁、响应式设计和高度可扩展性为核心特色。它提供完整的 API 支持与模块化扩展机制，适合快速搭建现代化社区平台，采用 MIT 许可证确保完全开放。
repos.summary_en: Flarum is a free, open-source forum software built with PHP and the Mithril JavaScript framework, emphasizing simplicity, responsiveness, and extensibility. It offers a modular architecture with comprehensive APIs for customization, ideal for building modern online communities under MIT license.

repos.description: 微信公众平台 Python 开发包 [DEPRECATED]
repos.summary_zh: wechat-python-sdk 是一个已停止维护的微信公众平台 Python 开发包，支持订阅号和服务号官方接口，提供消息处理、加解密、模板消息等功能。该 SDK 设计为轻量级，便于集成到各类 Web 框架中，不处理 HTTP 请求响应，仅封装微信 API 操作并返回合规响应数据。
repos.summary_en: wechat-python-sdk was a deprecated Python SDK for WeChat Official Accounts (subscription/service accounts), offering message handling, encryption/decryption, template messages, and menu management. It focused on simplifying WeChat API integration by returning compliant response data without handling HTTP layers, designed for easy integration into web frameworks.

repos.description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

repos.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
repos.summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
repos.summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

repos.description: 文颜- Markdown文章排版美化工具，支持微信公众号、今日头条、知乎等平台。
repos.summary_zh: 文颜是一款专为 Markdown 内容创作者设计的排版美化工具，支持一键将 Markdown 文章转换为适配微信公众号、知乎、今日头条等主流平台的富文本格式，内置多款 Typora 主题并支持自定义样式，自动处理图片上传与数学公式渲染，让写作者专注于内容创作而非繁琐排版。
repos.summary_en: Wenyan is a Markdown formatting and publishing tool designed for content creators, enabling one-click conversion of Markdown articles into platform-specific rich text formats for WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, Toutiao, and more. It features built-in Typora themes, custom styling, automatic image uploads, MathJax support, and seamless cross-platform publishing.

repos.description: 使用vercel的functions，将ai功能加入微信公众号
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 Vercel Functions 实现零服务器成本部署，将 AI 功能接入微信公众号，支持 GPT、星火、通义千问、Gemini 等多种大模型，具备连续对话、自定义指令、关键词回复、图床等功能，通过 Redis 实现会话记忆，无需备案域名即可运行。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages Vercel Functions to deploy AI-powered WeChat Official Account integration with zero server cost. It supports multiple AI models (GPT, Spark, Qwen, Gemini), continuous conversations via Redis, custom commands, keyword replies, image hosting, and system prompt configuration, all without domain registration or server maintenance.

repos.description: 爬取微信公众号文章
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库通过搜狗微信接口爬取微信公众号文章，支持获取账号信息、文章列表及全文内容，集成反爬虫机制与动态渲染技术，适用于内容聚合与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository scrapes WeChat Official Account articles via Sogou's WeChat search platform, supporting account info retrieval, article list parsing, and full content extraction. It includes anti-scraping measures and dynamic rendering support for content aggregation and data analysis.

repos.description: Claude Code 公众号一键排版+发布技能 | Markdown → 微信兼容 HTML → 推送草稿箱 | 30 套主题 + 可视化画廊
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的微信公众号一键排版工具，支持 Markdown 转微信兼容 HTML、30 套主题可视化预览、AI 内容增强（对话/图片容器）及直接推送草稿箱，覆盖新闻、科技、设计等多场景风格。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for seamless WeChat Official Account publishing: converts Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML, offers 30 visual themes with AI-enhanced content (dialogue/gallery containers), and enables one-click draft publishing via WeChat API.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: weixin pay python 微信支付功能集，前期开发借鉴zwczou https://github.com/zwczou/weixin-python ，后期补充及完善微信支付新功能，处理因微信支付调用规则修改而无法使用的旧代码，升级到最新微信支付接口配套代码
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个已停止维护的微信支付 Python SDK，提供完整的微信支付功能封装，包括 JSAPI 支付下单、订单查询、退款、红包发放、企业付款及刷卡支付等接口。基于 zwczou/weixin-python 开发，后期适配微信支付接口规则变更，支持证书认证和回调通知，适用于需要集成微信支付功能的 Python 后端服务。
repos.summary_en: This is a discontinued Python SDK for WeChat Pay, offering comprehensive API support including JSAPI payments, order queries, refunds, red packet distribution, enterprise transfers, and swipe-card payments. Built upon zwczou/weixin-python with updates to comply with WeChat Pay's evolving API standards, it supports certificate authentication and webhook notifications for secure payment processing in Python backends.

repos.description: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
repos.summary_zh: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
repos.summary_en: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到企业微信，无须VPN，速度快
repos.summary_zh: 本项目实现零代码一键部署ChatGPT至企业微信，无需翻墙，支持手机端与电脑端使用。基于OpenAI API构建，提供智能问答、客服自动化等能力，适用于企业内部沟通、客户服务及营销场景，大幅降低沟通成本并提升效率。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into WeCom (WeChat Enterprise), with no need for VPN. It integrates OpenAI's ChatGPT API to deliver intelligent Q&A and automated customer service, enhancing internal communication and business efficiency across mobile and desktop platforms.

repos.description: Any Agent × Any Provider × Anywhere. Connect Cursor, Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex to Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat — with any LLM provider.
repos.summary_zh: GolemBot 是一个革命性工具，允许将 Cursor、Claude Code、OpenCode 或 Codex 等任意 AI 编程代理与任何 LLM 提供商集成，并部署到即时通讯（IM）、HTTP 接口或自有产品中。它通过单一配置实现跨平台运行，无需修改代码或依赖特定 AI 框架，支持 13,000+ OpenClaw 社区技能，极大扩展了 AI 代理的应用场景。
repos.summary_en: GolemBot enables running any coding agent (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) with any LLM provider and deploying it to IM platforms, HTTP endpoints, or custom products. It requires zero code changes, supports 13,000+ OpenClaw community skills, and integrates seamlessly via configuration—no AI framework dependency.

repos.description: Local-first Windows WeChat memory archive with traceable PDF, Markdown, and JSON exports｜本地优先的微信个人记忆库
repos.summary_zh: 微信 AI 记忆库是一款本地优先的桌面工具，直接从 Windows 微信 4.x 读取聊天记录，支持按会话、日期和关键词筛选，可导出 PDF、Markdown 与结构化 JSON。全程仅操作临时数据库副本，图片恢复、语音转写（faster-whisper）均在本机完成，无任何数据上传。
repos.summary_en: WeChat AI Memory is a local-first desktop tool that directly reads Windows WeChat 4.x chat data, supports filtering by conversation, date, and keywords, and exports to PDF, Markdown, and structured JSON. All operations—including image recovery and voice transcription via faster-whisper—stay on-device with zero data uploads.

repos.description: WeSpy 是一个用于获取wx公众号文章并转换为 Markdown 格式的 Python 工具
repos.summary_zh: WeSpy 是一个专为微信公众号设计的 Python 工具，可抓取文章并转换为 Markdown 格式，支持防盗链处理、专辑批量下载及多格式输出（Markdown/HTML/JSON），提供命令行和 Python API 两种使用方式。
repos.summary_en: WeSpy is a Python tool designed for scraping WeChat Official Account articles and converting them to Markdown format. It supports anti-hotlinking image handling, batch album downloads, and multi-format output (Markdown/HTML/JSON), with both CLI and Python API interfaces.

repos.description: A robot of wechat based on python (Not maintained)
repos.summary_zh: wechat-bot 是一个基于 Python 开发的微信机器人项目，支持通过配置文件自定义端口、令牌、用户名等参数，集成 simsimi 等对话接口，提供基础的消息处理与自动回复功能，适用于简单的微信自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: wechat-bot is a Python-based WeChat robot that supports configuration via a text file for port, token, username, and simsimi integration, enabling basic message handling and automated replies for simple WeChat automation use cases.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: 文科生也会配的微信个人号后台，Content based wechat massive platform framework, what you need to do is only adding your articles in :)
repos.summary_zh: MyPlatform 是一个专为非技术用户设计的微信个人号内容管理平台，支持通过添加文章快速搭建微信公众号。基于 Python 开发，部署于新浪云（SAE），完全免费且配置简单，文科生也可在20分钟内完成搭建，实现内容分发与互动功能。
repos.summary_en: MyPlatform is a content-based WeChat personal account backend framework designed for non-technical users. Built with Python and hosted on SAE, it enables quick setup by adding articles, allowing anyone to create a functional WeChat content platform in under 20 minutes with zero cost.

repos.description: command line interface for weixin-robot
repos.summary_zh: webot-cli 是微信机器人（weixin-robot）的命令行接口工具，支持发送文本、图片、位置等消息，以及创建、删除、获取微信自定义菜单。通过配置文件管理 appid 和 secret，结合 webot 框架可实现消息自动响应与事件触发，适用于本地测试与快速开发微信机器人应用。
repos.summary_en: webot-cli is a command-line interface for weixin-robot, enabling sending text, image, location, and event messages to WeChat. It supports managing custom menus via JSON configuration, integrates with webot framework for automated responses, and is ideal for local testing and rapid development of WeChat bot applications.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
repos.summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.description: 一个发布 Telegram 翻译的 Bot
repos.summary_zh: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot 是一个用于发布 Telegram 中文翻译的自动化 Bot，支持通过命令上传和管理 Android、iOS、桌面端语言文件。用户发送语言文件获取 file_id 后，使用 /setandroid、/setios、/setdesktop 命令绑定文件槽，实现多平台翻译包的高效分发。
repos.summary_en: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot is an automated bot for publishing Telegram Chinese translations. It allows users to upload language files via commands (/setandroid, /setios, /setdesktop) using file_id, enabling efficient distribution of localized packages across platforms.
